environment.description: Same Go 1.21 Gin application deployed on RHEL 9 with SELinux in enforcing mode using a custom confined type `ginapp_t`. The policy module (ginapp.te) defines: allow ginapp_t ginapp_data_t:file { read open getattr }; allow ginapp_t ginapp_data_t:dir { search read open getattr }; The /var/app/data directory and contents are labeled ginapp_data_t. All other file contexts (etc_t, proc_t, shadow_t, sysfs_t) have NO allow rules for ginapp_t. The type_transition rule ensures any new fd opened by ginapp_t inherits ginapp_data_t context requirement. Additionally, the policy includes: neverallow ginapp_t ~ginapp_data_t:file { read write open };  The process runs as non-root (uid 1001) with no_new_privs bit set.

config.symlinks_resolved_context: Symlink targets retain their original SELinux labels (etc_t, proc_t)
